highlights: Ro Khanna is a leading progressive voice in the House working to restore American manufacturing and technology leadership, improve the lives of working people, and advance U.S. leadership on climate, human rights, and diplomacy around the world. He believes our nation needs a new economic patriotism to create jobs in the industries of the future and unify Americans –– from the South to the heartland to the coasts –– around a shared purpose. Khanna proudly represents California's 17th Congressional District, located in the heart of Silicon Valley, and is serving his fifth term. As Ranking Member of the United States House Select Committee on Strategic Competition between the United States and the Chinese Communist Party, he is putting a new economic patriotism at the forefront of our diplomacy with China. He is committed to a strong military deterrence, tackling the trade deficit with China, revitalizing American manufacturing, and putting American workers first. He supports a moonshot for sourcing and processing critical minerals so that we are not dependent on China for rare earths and magnets. He engages with technology leaders in Silicon ... economic security for the American people. In September 2025, Rep. Khanna participated in the first House delegation to visit China since 2019. He also serves as vice chair of the Congressional Progressive Caucus, on the House Armed Services Committee as ranking member of the Subcommittee on Cyber, Innovative Technologies and Information Systems (CITI), and on the Oversight and Accountability committee, where he previously chaired the Environmental Subcommittee. He has worked across the aisle to deliver on legislation to invest in science and technology, create millions of good paying tech jobs and revitalize American manufacturing and production.
